description: Verify that DUT denies a UDP datagram whose Destination Address is the all-systems multicast 224.0.0.1 — TC8 inverts the RFC 1122 §4.1.1 SHOULD-allow per its automotive security negotiation note
approach:
[Objective]
Like INTRODUCTION_01 but the trigger is multicast: 224.0.0.1 is the all-systems group every IPv4 host is a member of. TC8 v3.0 treats it as a security risk for ECUs and DUT must drop datagrams sent there.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester → DUT: IPv4 UDP packet
   • dst_ip = 224.0.0.1   ← key trigger
   • dst_port = a port DUT's upper-tester would normally listen on

2. Observation:
   • DUT's upper-tester must NOT receive the datagram

[Pass condition]
UT-query confirms DUT did not deliver the all-systems multicast UDP to upper-tester.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_wrong_receipt — DUT actually delivered the multicast UDP (security policy not enforced)
• Fail_timeout — UT-query never arrived (test infra issue, indeterminate)

verdicts.Pass: DUT denied the all-systems multicast UDP — normal
verdicts.Fail_wrong_receipt: DUT received the all-systems multicast UDP
verdicts.Fail_timeout: No UT confirmation for multicast deny
